messages:
maria: Heads-up — Kibana counts for correlation_hash=0x9f3b show ~2.3k error lines in the 10:00-10:10 window but Loki returns ~210. Something's off. Anyone seen this before?
kevin: Ugh. Which index pattern/timezone are you using in Kibana? sometimes ES ingest pipes timestamps differently and we end up with a wider slip.
maria: Kibana -> logs-* index, UTC filter, timepicker 10:00-10:10 UTC. I double-checked timezone.
jon: Could be multiline logs collapsed in Loki or batch-ingest deduping. Also check label normalization — if Kibana stores the raw "correlation_hash" field and Loki label is trimmed we might be missing matches.
maria: Good call. Loki query I ran:
```
{job="inference"} |= "correlation_hash=0x9f3b" | count_over_time(10m)
```
returns 210. Kibana shows 2.3k documents with `correlation_hash.keyword: 0x9f3b`.
kevin: Try a substring match in Loki — sometimes we escape differently. Also check if Kibana is counting both stdout/stderr and Loki only scrapes stdout.
jon: Another gotcha: GPU preempt logs sometimes emit the hash prefixed like "corr=0x9f3b" in a different field. Try a looser LogQL:
```
{job="inference"} |= "0x9f3b" | json
```
or
```
{job="inference"} |~ "(?i)0x9f3b" | count_over_time(10m)
```
maria: Ran the regex one — it jumped to 1.9k. So we were losing ~400 lines due to label/quote differences. Still short of 2.3k though.
kevin: The remaining delta could be from our ES ingest pipeline which also stores metrics/metricbeat entries and Kubernetes events that never hit Loki. Kibana can count k8s events and filebeat-derived messages too.
sre-oncall: Also check for log retention/archival on Loki ingestion pipeline — we had a drop around 10:04 when a node rotated. I can check the shard logs.
logbot: [alert] loki-pushgateway-1 reported write_retries > 5 at 2028-04-12T10:04:23Z
jon: There we go. If the pushgateway retried and timed out, some logs might have been dropped at push time. Correlate with pushgateway metrics:
```
rate(loki_push_push_total{job="pushgateway"}[5m])
```
kevin: For future debugging let's standardize on embedding `trace_id` in the log line too. Correlation_hash is fine for app-level grouping but trace systems (tempo/jaeger) use trace_id and we can join by that.
maria: We do include trace_id occasionally but it's not always emitted when a GPU preempt triggers an early shutdown. Those handlers only print correlation_hash.
sre-oncall: Action items: 1) add a shortfix so preempt handler also logs trace_id (low friction) 2) make Loki label normalization rule for correlation_hash (drop quotes) 3) add an alert when loki_push_retries spikes during scale events.
kevin: I'll create a small normalization pipeline for promtail to add label `correlation_hash_clean` using regex replace to a canonical hex string.
jon: For immediate triage, Maria — run this Kibana query to pull the non-logstash sources: `NOT _exists_:logstash_index` AND `correlation_hash:0x9f3b` and see results. Might reveal k8s events / kubelet messages.
maria: Will do. Also forwarding the pushgateway metrics + node rotation logs to the incident channel.
kevin: Long-term we should add a dashboard showing "log ingestion vs es_count vs loki_count" per correlation_hash sample to detect drifts. Grafana panel idea: three-series comparison with a small table of top-deltas.
sre-oncall: Agree. Small SLO: keep Loki/Kibana parity within 5% for high-frequency correlation_hash values. Create a ticket?
maria: Filing ticket INF-492: "canonicalize correlation_hash across ingesters + add trace_id to preempt handler". Assign to kevin + jon.
jon: Quick tip — when searching for truncated stacks, include `|~ "\\n"` in LogQL to catch escaped newlines sometimes stored as `\n`. saved me last week. :sweat_smile: 
maria: Nice. That regex found another ~120 multiline lines that were collapsed. Now totals are ~2.1k vs Kibana 2.3k — remaining 200 looks like k8s events.
kevin: Good enough for now. We'll close the loop in INF-492 when normalization is live. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
